ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio with high dominance of low-intensity (dark) pixels exceeding 90% of the visible surface; localized high-intensity (white) pixels are sparse and isolated.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary pigmentation is a contiguous dark charcoal-to-black field. High-contrast white features include a distinct linear stroke on the lower-left lobe and irregular light-grey mottling concentrated near the median notch and central lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; visible angle approximately 50-60 degrees; lower vertex depth is partially obscured by dynamic water-splash pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; trailing edge consists of a series of jagged peaks (5-15 pixels in amplitude) interspersed with deep irregular valleys, particularly prominent on the right lobe distal region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a broad convex curve transitioning to a straight trailing edge. The right lobe demonstrates a sharper, more vertical orientation with a pronounced distal convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular nodules visible at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, highly distinct diagonal linear disruption of white pixels located on the lower-left fluke lobe, cutting across the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular geometric indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, forming a jagged, multi-stepped excision from the natural contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse grey-scale stippling visible on the inner fluke surface near the junction of the two lobes.
